ui.longTermMemory.tour.activityText: Every reply gets a line here: what I recalled, what I left out and what I saved.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.inchatText: I only bring up what fits the moment. My icon in the chat opens this card after each reply.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.inchatTextOff: Once I'm on in a chat, my icon there opens a card with what I used in the last reply.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.linkedText: I connect memories that belong together, so one can bring the other along. The Graph draws them as a map.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.linkedTextExample: I connect memories that belong together, so one can bring the other along. This is an example; yours will be drawn the same way.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.readingText: I read new replies in the background. Keep chatting; I'll file what matters.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.readingTitle: While this chip shows, I'm reading
ui.longTermMemory.tour.reviewText: When I'm not sure about something, it waits here until you say yes. The number on the tab counts what's waiting.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.settingsText: These apply to all chats. Each chat's own choices sit in its chat settings. That's the tour!
ui.longTermMemory.tour.sourcesText: Hand me lorebooks, characters or old chats and I'll read them for you.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.vaultText: Everything I keep lives here. The chip says where it came from. Tap one to fix it or forget it.
ui.longTermMemory.tour.welcomeText: Let me show you around. Nine quick stops, and you can leave any time.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.title: What's new in Long-Term Memory 1.6
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.intro: Mari reorganised the archive. Here is what changed.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.graphText: See your memories as linked circles, on a phone too.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.activityText: Which memories each reply used, and why.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.branchesText: A branch remembers what its parent saved, and the parent remembers the branch's.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.recallText: Matches the meaning of your latest messages, even short ones.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.extractionTex: Story-level memories, fewer repeats, and a re-read never replaces good ones.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.sharingText: Choose which Agents can read or add memories.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more1: Recall is set by one token budget and only uses whole memories.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more2: Choose how many of the latest messages the AI always sees.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more3: Leave the newest messages unread until the scene has moved on.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more4: "Save them for me" also saves new characters and relationships.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more5: Review keeps a suggestion in one press and says why others were skipped.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more6: Sources is one list, with each preview opening under its row.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more7: The Vault has Back up, Restore, a Fix bar and a History for each memory.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more8: Memory Settings has two tabs, shorter hints and one way to save.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.more9: Setup and the tour are guided by Mari, with an example graph.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.mergeText: Review offers Merge or Keep both.
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.rereadTitle: Re-read a chat with the new rules
ui.longTermMemory.whatsnew.rereadText: Use Re-extract in Sources. Try one chat first.
